description: Self-hosted from .github/workflows/renovate.yml. Every pin zdev has: Go and its modules, the Dockerfile, the workflows' actions, and in internal/config/defaults.go the images and downloaded tools (keep the customManagers in sync with the shapes in defaults_test.go).

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Fixes for known vulnerabilities come at once: Renovate's defaults exempt them from the schedule and the release age

customManagers.description: Images in defaults.go: a `// renovate: datasource=docker` line above `XImage = "repo:tag"`
Downloaded tools in defaults.go: a renovate line above `X = ToolRelease{Name: "x", Version: "v",`
Plain versions in defaults.go: a renovate line above `X = "version"`
go install in the dev Dockerfile: a `# renovate:` line above `go install module@version`

packageRules.description: Go itself: the go directive (not bumped by default) and the dev image, in one PR
Go modules' minor and patch updates in one PR
The workflows' actions in one PR (SHA and version comment)
A downloaded tool's new version needs new checksums: Renovate can't compute them, scripts/pinsums downloads and writes them
